note: THREE WAYS make board-post BITES, all silent or misleading, all hit in one session. (1) DOUBLE QUOTES INSIDE NOTE BREAK IT. The Makefile interpolates NOTE into a note=... argument and the tool splits on whitespace looking for key=value, so an inner double-quoted phrase ends the token early. Symptom: board: expected key=value, got <the second word of your phrase>, then make Error 2 — nothing about quoting. Fix: no double quotes in NOTE; hyphenate the phrase instead. Single quotes around the whole NOTE are required and fine. (2) A LITERAL DOLLAR-PAREN-NOTE IN THE TEXT makes make recurse on its own variable: Makefile:226 Recursive variable NOTE references itself. Stop. So you cannot document trap 1 by quoting the Makefile line that causes it. Use prose. (3) PATHS is its own variable precisely because a JSON array passed through FIELDS loses its quotes to the shell and silently degrades a path-routed post into a broadcast — that one is already in CLAUDE.md, and it is the same root cause as 1 and 2: this interface is whitespace-and-shell-fragile in three different layers.
